focus.translation: 虽然人们喜欢集中于不同的方面，但是我认为大部分的差不多。

focus.sentence: All in all, I think my hobbies are balanced; they bring some relaxation to my life, and at the same time bring focus to my studies.
focus.translation: 大体上，我认为我的爱好很均衡，它们给我的生活带来轻松，并同时为我学习带来更集中的精力。

focus.sentence: These days many young people work without much focus; my friend's son hadn't gone two years after graduating before he'd changed jobs five times.
focus.translation: 现在许多年轻人工作都不太安分，朋友的儿子大学毕业不到两年，已经换了五个工作了。

optimistic.sentence: His view seems to be too optimistic.
optimistic.translation: 他的看法似乎太乐观了。

hail.sentence: Have you ever seen it hail?
hail.translation: 你什么时候看见过冰雹吗？

hail.sentence: There's no need to hail a taxi.
We marched under a hail of bullets.
hail.translation: 我们在枪林弹雨之下行进。

consequence.sentence: It is of no consequence to me that he is coming.
consequence.translation: 他要来这件事对我而言无关紧要。

consequence.sentence: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
consequence.translation: 由于一些写得糟糕的函数，系统大多数情况下不稳定。

consequence.sentence: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
consequence.translation: 由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

worth.sentence: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.

cherish.sentence: Cherish our cultural relics; it is all our duty.
cherish.translation: 爱护文物, 人人有责。

cherish.sentence: It is everyone's duty to cherish cultural relics.
cherish.translation: 爱护文物, 人人有责。

cherish.sentence: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.
cherish.translation: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。

set.sentence: Hanako is set on going to Paris.
The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.

jar.sentence: There are some cookies in the jar.
This jam jar's lid is stuck and won't open.
jar.translation: 这个果酱瓶的盖子卡住了，打不开。

rocket.sentence: The rocket was launched into space.

anthem.sentence: The text of the national anthem of Canada was first written in French.
anthem.translation: 加拿大国歌的歌词最初是用法文写的。

unfit.sentence: He is unfit to be a teacher.

engine.translation: 这名技师组装了这台引擎。

engine.sentence: Before the fire engine arrived, the whole house was burnt down.
engine.translation: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。

vest.sentence: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
vest.translation: 背心反了， 要翻一个面。

vest.sentence: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
vest.translation: 汤姆穿著一件防弹衣，所以子弹没把他杀死。

urban.sentence: Traffic is a major urban problem.
urban.translation: 交通是都市的一个主要问题。

urban.sentence: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
urban.translation: 越来越多的人迁往乡村。

urban.sentence: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.
urban.translation: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。

renaissance.sentence: With Renaissance, scholastic ideas gave place to positive ideas.
renaissance.translation: 随著文艺复兴，学院派的想法被积极的想法取而代之了。

temptation.sentence: She gave in to the temptation.
Finally she gave in to temptation and ate the whole cake.
temptation.translation: 她终于受不了诱惑，吃掉了整件蛋糕。

temptation.sentence: Because he was just like a child, he yielded to temptation.
temptation.translation: 因为他跟孩子很像， 他受诱惑了

necklace.sentence: My grandma gave me this necklace.
necklace.translation: 这条项链是我奶奶送给我的。

necklace.sentence: Tom found Mary's necklace under the sofa.
necklace.translation: 在沙发下，汤姆找到了玛丽的项链。

fourth.sentence: I come here every Fourth of July.
fourth.translation: 我每年7月4号都会来这里。

fourth.sentence: My apartment is on the fourth floor.
My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
fourth.translation: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

rant.sentence: I just want to rant a little bit.

badly.sentence: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
badly.translation: 汤姆在交通意外中受了重伤。

badly.sentence: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
badly.translation: 我们这样待他，好像不是太好。

handicap.sentence: Having no will is the worst handicap.
handicap.translation: 没有愿望是最大的障碍。

aquarium.sentence: I needed to add water to my aquarium.
aquarium.translation: 我需要往我的鱼缸里加水。

princess.sentence: She dreamed that she was a princess.
At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.
princess.translation: 最后，马里奥设法赢得公主的爱。

princess.sentence: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
princess.translation: 你妹妹看上去那么高贵，就像是个公主一样。

mail.sentence: Sorry I didn't e-mail you sooner.
mail.translation: 抱歉，我没有早点写e-mail给你。

mail.sentence: Please remember to mail the letter.
The mail train lost most of its mail in the fire.
mail.translation: 那场火灾把邮车上的邮件烧掉了一大半。

contrived.sentence: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
contrived.translation: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

precise.sentence: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.
precise.translation: 他给我的工作作出了明确指示。

precise.sentence: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
precise.translation: 他们到逹的确切时间还不知道。

precise.sentence: Our teacher is someone who likes precision, and always demands precise answers of her students.
precise.translation: 老师性喜精准——她总是要求精确的答案。

guide.sentence: I'll act as a guide for you.
They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.
guide.translation: 他们和一个导游一起出发，只是为了以防迷路。

dessert.sentence: What would you like for dessert?
I'd like to have cake for dessert.
I'm trying to save room for dessert.

purification.sentence: He taught contemplation as a means of spiritual purification and the attainment of the Dao, a principle that signifies the highest spiritual ideals of mankind.
purification.translation: 他为精神的洁净和获得道的方法教深思，道是表示人类最高的精神理想的一个原则。

rapid.sentence: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
rapid.translation: 在这么急的急流里游泳，一定会很危险的。

rapid.sentence: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
rapid.translation: 医生认为病人的脉搏有点快。

rapid.sentence: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
rapid.translation: 电脑产业的发展一日千里。

invade.sentence: People shouldn't be allowed to invade countries whose names they can't pronounce correctly.
invade.translation: 人们不应该侵犯自己读不正确名字的国家。

protect.sentence: You have to wear a helmet to protect your head.
protect.translation: 你要戴上头盔来保护你的头部。

protect.sentence: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
protect.translation: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

protect.sentence: He has in his possession films that were never distributed to cinemas to protect them against piracy.
protect.translation: 为了防止盗版，他有些电影从未在影院上映。

convert.sentence: He is a recent convert to Catholicism.
convert.translation: 他新近皈依的天主教徒。

smoothly.sentence: This car is running less smoothly than it used to.
smoothly.translation: 这辆车没有以前跑得那么顺畅了。

smoothly.sentence: In order to move the project along smoothly, we have revised the plan several times.
smoothly.translation: 为了顺利推进项目，我们已经修订了几次计划。

download.sentence: If you don't have this software, you can download it now.
download.translation: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。

theory.sentence: I think your basic theory is wrong.
theory.translation: 我认为你的基本理论是错的。

theory.sentence: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
theory.translation: 一提到进化论，我们就会想起达尔文。

array.sentence: Behind every animal on the Chinese zodiac lies an array of proverbs, sayings and stories.
array.translation: 每一个生肖的背后都有著数不尽的成语、谚语和故事。

opiate.sentence: Religion is the opiate of the masses.

meteor.sentence: Tomorrow we are going to see the meteor shower!

olive.sentence: We'd like to order 18 tonnes of olive oil.

throat.sentence: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.

shell.sentence: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
shell.translation: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

shell.sentence: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
shell.translation: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

enrich.sentence: You should enrich your mind when young.
enrich.translation: 年轻的时候你应该开拓你的思想。

handsome.sentence: He is young and, what is more, handsome.
handsome.translation: 他很年轻，更重要的是，他很帅。

handsome.sentence: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
handsome.translation: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。

prosperity.sentence: The horse does not just represent energy, high spirits, prosperity, development, but also stands for a national spirit of struggling on without stopping, and of striving on without giving up.
prosperity.translation: 马不但象征著刚健、高昂、昌盛、发达，还代表著奋斗不止、自强不息的民族精神。

prosperity.sentence: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people.
prosperity.translation: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到

obligatory.sentence: Is it obligatory to rent a car?

bore.sentence: Our real life friends may sometimes bore us, but the friends we find in books would never do that.
bore.translation: 我们生活中的朋友有时会让我们觉得无聊，而我们书中的朋友永远不会这样。

hammer.sentence: Tom took the hammer away from Mary.
hammer.translation: 汤姆从玛丽那里拿走了锤子。

hammer.sentence: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?
hammer.translation: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。

hammer.sentence: This is a hammer. It's not mine; I borrowed it from a friend.
hammer.translation: 这是锤子。不是我的，借一个朋友的。

quarrel.sentence: Don't quarrel with him any more.
I want to put an end to the quarrel.

quarrel.translation: 他们的争吵因误解而起。

recording.sentence: I bet you'd never heard of a Stroh violin before Tom Waits dug it back up! Anyway, it used a large metal horn as its resonator instead of a wooden box so it could be picked up better by recording equipment before the late 1920s.
recording.translation: 我敢打赌，在Tom Waits发掘它当幕后支援前你从来没有听说过斯特罗小提琴！无论如何，1920年代末前它采用了一个大型金属喇叭谐振器来代替木制音箱，以便它可以更好地被录音设备收音。

thief.sentence: Procrastination is the thief of time.

lunar.sentence: 2010 was the Year of the Tiger in the Chinese lunar calendar.
The first day of the first month in the Chinese lunar calendar is Spring Festival, the most important festival for the people of China.
lunar.translation: 中国农历年的一月一日为春节，是中国人民最隆重的传统节日。

lunar.sentence: Arriving at the end of each year (that is, the last day of the lunar calendar) wasn't just a new day taking over from the previous one, but also a new year taking over from the previous one, and this was called 'first exchange'.
lunar.translation: 到了每年的年底即年三十的时候，就不仅是新旧两天的更替，也是新旧岁的更替，称之为“交子”。

program.sentence: I've had enough of this program.
program.translation: 我已经受够了这个计划。

program.sentence: Tell me about your program for the future.
program.translation: 给我谈谈你未来的计划。

embassy.sentence: He has access to the American Embassy.
embassy.translation: 他有权出入美国大使馆。

embassy.sentence: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
embassy.translation: 大使馆就在最高法院旁边。

valley.sentence: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
valley.translation: 小山后面有个美丽的山谷。

valley.sentence: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.
valley.translation: 我们听见自己说话的回音从山谷的另一边传了回来。

valley.sentence: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.
valley.translation: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。

impossible.sentence: To live without air is impossible.
impossible.translation: 没有空气生活是不可能的。

impossible.sentence: It is impossible to master English in a short time.
impossible.translation: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

war.sentence: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
war.translation: 一旦爆发核战争，受苦的将会是全人类。

war.sentence: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
war.translation: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。

recession.sentence: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
recession.translation: 经济不景气失业率上升到了5％。

recession.sentence: Recession is a temporary falling off of business activity during a period when such activity is generally increasing.
recession.translation: 经济萧条是一段时间内，当这样的经济活动普遍增长而造成的一种临时性的经济活动衰退。

conservation.sentence: During the holidays, some university students go to Africa as volunteers and help to perfect local wildlife conservation.
conservation.translation: 一些大学生在假期去非洲做志愿者 ，帮助当地完善野生生物管理。

conservation.sentence: The giant panda is recognised as a national treasure of China, but in some conservation areas it is still killed by poachers.
conservation.translation: 大熊猫被认为是中国的国宝，但在一些保护区，它仍被偷猎。

still.sentence: It is still fresh in my memory.
Space science is still in its infancy.
Admitting what you say, I still think you are in the wrong.
still.translation: 虽然我承认你说的,但是我仍然认为你是错的。

recognition.sentence: He gave me a smile of recognition.
recognition.translation: 他给了我一个认可的微笑。

recognition.sentence: She gave me a smile of recognition.
recognition.translation: 她给了我一个认可的微笑。

province.sentence: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
province.translation: 熊猫在四川省土生土长，不在任何其他省份的野外生活。

province.sentence: The Fuzhou Zoo in China's Fujian Province has done more than its counterparts in training pandas.
province.translation: 中国福建省福州市动物园在训练大熊猫方面做得比它的同行多。

province.sentence: Taoism was founded on the teachings of Laozi, a sage born in 604 B.C. in present-day Henan Province.
province.translation: 道教是用老子的教导创立的，他是公元前六零四年在现代的河南省出生的圣贤。

fragrance.sentence: These flowers have a really nice fragrance.

conquer.sentence: The Romans would never have had the chance to conquer the world if they had first been required to study Latin.
conquer.translation: 如果他们必须先学拉丁文的话，是没有机会让罗马人征服世界的对吧。

conquer.sentence: When there was despair in the dust bowl and depression across the land, she saw a nation conquer fear itself with a New Deal, new jobs, a new sense of common purpose. Yes, we can.
conquer.translation: 当30年代的沙尘暴和大萧条使人们感到绝望时，她看到一个国家用新政、新的就业机会以及对新目标的共同追求战胜恐慌。是的，我们能做到。

repetition.sentence: Repetition is the mother of memory.

chiefly.sentence: Interlingua is an international auxiliary language developed between 1937 and 1951 by the IALA (International Auxiliary Language Association). Its vocabulary and grammar is chiefly derived from five control languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and Italian.
chiefly.translation: 国际语是IALA（国际辅助语言协会）于1937年至1951年间开发的一门国际辅助语言。 它的词汇和语法主要来源于五种控制语言：英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、法语和意大利语。

drinking.sentence: My father tries to abstain from drinking.
Although Hiroko dislikes cigarette smoke, she readily goes out drinking with friends.
drinking.translation: 虽然弘子不喜欢香烟的烟雾，她却乐意和朋友出去喝酒。

trip.sentence: Did you buy a round trip ticket?

term.sentence: The first term starts in April.

You should turn in your term papers by the end of April.
term.translation: 请在四月底之前交上你的学期报告。

railway.sentence: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
railway.translation: 地图上的红线代表铁路。

railway.sentence: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
railway.translation: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。

railway.sentence: London is such a large city that visitors must use buses and the underground railway to get about.
railway.translation: 伦敦是个大城市，游客必须乘公交或地铁才能出行。

proficiency.sentence: I've heard it said that there is no way for you to ever reach native proficiency in a language if you haven't started studying it before the age of twelve.
proficiency.translation: 我听说，如果没在十二岁前开始学一个语言，是无法达到母语等级的。

miserable.sentence: Kate glanced at Chris and then ignored him, making him feel miserable.
miserable.translation: 凯特看了克里斯一眼，然后不理睬他，使他感到痛苦。

rainfall.sentence: We had a heavy rainfall last night.

toad.sentence: I cannot distinguish a frog from a toad.
toad.translation: 我无法区分青蛙和蟾蜍。

sheer.sentence: It is a sheer waste of time.

sheer.translation: 她在行李箱中放进了两条裤袜。

despicable.sentence: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.
despicable.translation: 我为你的卑鄙行径刚到羞耻。

cunning.sentence: People say that the fox is more cunning than other animals.
cunning.translation: 人们说，狐狸比其他动物要狡猾。

worried.sentence: Helen is very worried about her daughter.

worried.translation: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车上发现炸弹。

traitor.sentence: We have a traitor among us.

traitor.translation: 我们以为他是一个英雄，原来是一个叛徒。

chop.sentence: Actually I wanted to be a damsel in a tower guarded by seven dragons, and then a prince on a white horse would chop off the dragons' heads and liberate me.
chop.translation: 其实我想做一个被关在高塔里的少女，然后有一天，就会有一个白马王子出现，把守卫著高塔的七条龙通通杀掉，救我出来。

maternity.sentence: Little Wang is on maternity leave. She won't be back to work for six months.
maternity.translation: 小王休产假了，半年内都不会来上班。

performer.sentence: We gave the performer a clap.

momentary.sentence: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
momentary.translation: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

crab.sentence: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.
crab.translation: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。

bodyguard.sentence: The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.

hawk.sentence: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
hawk.translation: 那只鸟的体积有半只老鹰那么大。

mutual.sentence: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
mutual.translation: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。

grape.translation: 葡萄味的果冻是我最喜欢的。

grape.sentence: That isn't wine. It's grape juice.
grape.translation: 这不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。

yet.sentence: Have you answered that letter yet?

deprive.sentence: No one can deprive of your human rights.
deprive.translation: 没有人能剥夺你的人权。

deprive.sentence: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
deprive.translation: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。

designation.sentence: With North Korea's announcement on the 26th of its nuclear development plan based upon the agreement stemming from the Six Party Talks, and the United States' commencement of procedures to remove North Korea from its designation on the list of State Sponsors of Terrorism, the families of abductees have expressed growing unease that it may constitute an abandonment of the abductee issue.
designation.translation: 随着北朝鲜在26号宣布了按照六方谈话上达成的共识所制定的核计划发展，美国将其从美国的恐怖主义捐助国的名单上去除。被绑架者的家属表达了不安，因为这有可能造成对绑架问题的放弃。

portion.sentence: He finished the steak, then ordered another portion.
portion.translation: 他吃完肉排又点了一份。

portion.sentence: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
portion.translation: 我们会把一部分筹得的款项用来帮助残疾儿童。

destroy.sentence: If you want to be free, destroy your television set.
destroy.translation: 你想成为自由就摧毁你的电视。

pen.translation: 用钢笔写，不要用铅笔写。

disco.sentence: When he was a student, he went to the disco only once.
disco.translation: 当他还是个学生时，他只去过迪厅一次。

disco.sentence: They kicked him out of the disco without any explanation.
disco.translation: 他们什么也没解释就把他踢出迪斯科了。

defeatist.sentence: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
defeatist.translation: 抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

fiscal.sentence: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
fiscal.translation: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。

become.sentence: The volcano has become active again.
become.translation: 这座火山又开始活动了。

become.sentence: We've become a mockery to the whole village.
become.translation: 我们成了整个村庄的笑柄。

immigrate.sentence: When did you immigrate to our country?
immigrate.translation: 你何时移民到我们国家?

jealous.sentence: He was jealous of my success.
They are jealous of our success.
I suppose I felt a little jealous.

help.sentence: If you're busy, I'll help you.

fact.sentence: Only a handful of people know the fact.
fact.translation: 知道真相的人只有几个。

fact.sentence: Tom is not a lazy boy. As a matter of fact, he works hard.
fact.translation: 汤姆其实并不懒，相反他很勤奋。

fact.sentence: The fact that television frequently limits communication within families is already well known.
fact.translation: 电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。

mouthful.sentence: She gulped down half her tea in one mouthful.
mouthful.translation: 她一口气喝下多半杯凉茶。

festal.sentence: Each age has deemed the new-born year the fittest time for festal cheer.
festal.translation: 岁岁皆为新生之年，都值得好好庆祝。

action.sentence: Your action has offended his dignity.
action.translation: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。

action.sentence: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
action.translation: 接下来该采取什么行动就交给你了。

attract.sentence: After business came to a halt, many bathhouses added new facilities, such as saunas and exercise equipment, in an effort to attract customers.
attract.translation: 生意停顿了以后，许多公共浴堂都添置了桑拿浴室、健身器材等的新设备，希望能吸引多点人来光顾。

operate.sentence: The doctor decided to operate at once.
Do you know how to operate a computer?
operate.translation: 你知道怎么操作电脑吗？

operate.sentence: I don't know how to operate this computer.
operate.translation: 我不知道怎么操作这台电脑.

unusual.sentence: The weather has been unusual this year.
The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
unusual.translation: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。

unusual.sentence: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
unusual.translation: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

areas.sentence: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
areas.translation: 越来越多的人迁往乡村。

areas.sentence: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.
areas.translation: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。

areas.sentence: The giant panda is recognised as a national treasure of China, but in some conservation areas it is still killed by poachers.
areas.translation: 大熊猫被认为是中国的国宝，但在一些保护区，它仍被偷猎。

soy.sentence: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
soy.translation: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。

soy.sentence: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
soy.translation: 把米饭和鸡蛋还有酱油拌在了一起。

snacks.sentence: Eating snacks is a bad habit.
If you want to become thin, you should cut back on the between-meal snacks.
snacks.translation: 如果你想变瘦，就应该少点在正餐以外吃零食。

emotional.sentence: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
emotional.translation: 对一个科学家来说，多愁善感是不好的。

emotional.sentence: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
emotional.translation: 对一个科学家来说，情绪化是不好的。

emotional.sentence: I can't keep this up. It's an emotional roller coaster around here and all we have to do is look at the boss's face to know whether everybody is going to be happy or sad.
emotional.translation: 我们上班时的情绪，就像坐过山车一样 ﹣ 老板脸上一现出不悦的神色，我们就要吃苦头；老板脸上有了笑容，我们才能松一口气。这样的工作，我不想再干下去了。

blackboard.sentence: Ann wrote something on the blackboard.
Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
blackboard.translation: 比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

normal.sentence: After a six month period, his leg was healed and is normal again.
normal.translation: 过了六个月，他的腿便治好，回复正常了。

normal.sentence: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.
normal.translation: 他只不过是个普普通通的中学生，不算特别聪明。

normal.sentence: I don't know if he has any special powers or not, but he's probably stronger than a normal human.
normal.translation: 我不知道他有没有超能力，但是我猜他可能比一般人要强吧。

summit.sentence: The summit of Mt. Fuji was covered in snow.
Who first reached the summit of Mt. Everest?
summit.translation: 最先登上珠穆朗玛峰的人是谁？

trap.sentence: Crap! I fell for his trap!
We set a trap to catch a fox.
trap.translation: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

delighted.sentence: I am delighted to meet you.
The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
delighted.translation: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

urge.sentence: I urge you to tell him the truth.
Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
urge.translation: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

urge.sentence: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
urge.translation: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

optional.sentence: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
optional.translation: 生命中你无法选择接踵而至的挑战，但是你可以选择不成为一个失败者。

together.sentence: We got all the materials together.
together.translation: 我们把所有的材料放在一起。

together.sentence: Some furniture is put together with glue.
together.translation: 一些家具是用胶水黏在一起。

necessity.sentence: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
necessity.translation: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

necessity.sentence: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
necessity.translation: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。

necessity.sentence: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
necessity.translation: 在美国，汽车并不是奢华的象征，而是生活的必需品。

clothing.sentence: You'll catch cold in such thin clothing.
You'll catch cold in such thin clothing.
I like shopping in used-book stores and in used-clothing shops.
clothing.translation: 我很喜欢逛二手书店和二手衣店。

struggle.sentence: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
struggle.translation: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。

struggle.sentence: He put up a brave and lone struggle, but up against such heavy odds he couldn't get his business plan accepted.
struggle.translation: 他提出了一个勇敢而孤独的斗争，但这些沉重的打击，他的赔率不能得到他的商业计划接受。

struggle.sentence: And tonight, I think about all that she's seen throughout her century in America. The heartache and the hope, the struggle and the progress. The times we were told that we can't, and the people who pressed on with that American creed: Yes, we can.
struggle.translation: 今天晚上，我想到了她在美国过去一百年间所经历的种种：心痛和希望；斗争和进步；在那里时代，我们被告知我们办不到，一些人继续坚信着美国的信念——是的，我们能做到。

thought.sentence: Have you ever thought of becoming a nurse?
thought.translation: 你曾经想过当个护士吗?

thought.sentence: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
thought.translation: 医生认为病人的脉搏有点快。

thought.sentence: Though she wished to travel abroad by herself, she thought better of it.
thought.translation: 尽管她想过一个人去国外旅行，她改变了主意。

millionaire.sentence: I'd like to be a millionaire.
Who wants to be a millionaire?
I'm going to be a millionaire.
millionaire.translation: 我就要成为百万富翁了。

patronizing.sentence: Is this patronizing or meddling in someone else's business?

bureaucracy.sentence: Algeria needs to get rid of its bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.translation: 阿尔及利亚需要摆脱官僚主义。

hill.sentence: The building on the hill is our school.
hill.translation: 山上的那栋建筑物就是我们的学校了。

hill.sentence: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
hill.translation: 跑上山后，我完全喘不过气来。

hill.sentence: A small road ran across the bridge, through the fields, and over a hill.
hill.translation: 一条小路跨过桥梁，穿过田野，还爬上小丘。

nonetheless.sentence: Carrefour's Ham offcuts are not expensive at all, but are nonetheless delicious.
nonetheless.translation: 家乐福的火腿剩料一点都不贵，然而却很好吃。

nonetheless.sentence: She was a tiny girl, but she really held her own on the baritone sax. Nonetheless, I couldn't help but imagine the thing wrapping itself around her and devouring her like a boa constrictor.
nonetheless.translation: 她是一个非常娇小的女孩，但她真的自己抱著中音萨克斯。不过，我忍不住想像这个东西缠绕包裹住她，并像蟒蛇般的吞噬她。

teens.sentence: My daughter is in her late teens.
My sister got married in her teens.
teens.translation: 我妹妹在她十几岁时就结婚。

teens.sentence: He was still in his teens when he founded a company.
teens.translation: 他成立了自己的公司的时候还不到二十岁。

bored.sentence: I was bored with his old jokes.
At the beginning, I was bored with radio gymnastics, but now I do not dislike it.
bored.translation: 我起初觉得广播体操很无聊，但是现在却喜欢上了。

sacrifice.sentence: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
sacrifice.translation: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

sacrifice.sentence: Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
sacrifice.translation: 父母为了确保孩子受到良好的教育常常牺牲自己。

sacrifice.sentence: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.
sacrifice.translation: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。

random.sentence: I used to read novels at random.
random.translation: 我从前有空时便会读读小说。

random.sentence: Why are people always called Tom in random sentences?
random.translation: 为什么随机句子中的人总是叫汤姆？

collection.sentence: I have a large collection of stamps.
I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
collection.translation: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

collection.sentence: It's the answer spoken by young and old, rich and poor, Democrat and Republican, black, white, Hispanic, Asian, Native American, gay, straight, disabled and not disabled. Americans who sent a message to the world that we have never been just a collection of individuals or a collection of red states and blue states. We are, and always will be, the United States of America.
collection.translation: 这是个由不分老少、贫富、民主党、共和党；黑人、白人、拉丁裔、亚裔、美洲原住民；同性恋、异性恋人；肢障与四体健全者，大家共同诉说的答案。美国民众向全世界发出讯息，我们绝非一盘散沙，也不是由红州、蓝州拼凑而成的集合体。

flavour.sentence: I especially like the flavour of the mushroom.
flavour.translation: 我特别喜欢蘑菇的味道。

flavour.sentence: If and only if the ice-cream is vanilla flavour will Xiao Wang eat it.
flavour.translation: 当且仅当冰淇淋是香草口味，小王会吃这个冰淇淋。

software.sentence: You really shouldn't use pirated software.
software.translation: 你真的不该用盗版软件。

software.sentence: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
software.translation: 我编译这个程序有些困难。

software.sentence: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
software.translation: Pierre电脑里有很多盗版软件。

abortion.sentence: Are you for or against abortion?
Do you support or oppose abortion?

listen.sentence: Mary won't listen to her friend's advice.
listen.translation: 玛丽不会听她朋友的忠告。

merchant.sentence: Yan Daxia realised he had been lied to and flew to Jiang Feng's side. He took Jiang Feng's son and left. Yan Daxia vowed revenge and left the boy with a spice merchant.
merchant.translation: 燕大侠发现自己被骗了他飞到了江枫的旁边，他抱走江枫的儿子。燕大侠誓言报复，他把男孩给了一个香料商人。

participate.sentence: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
Did the union participate in the demonstration?
participate.translation: 工会参加了示威游行吗？

participate.sentence: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
participate.translation: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。

counterproductive.sentence: ... Otherwise it is (or will be) hard to avoid a counterproductive situation.
counterproductive.translation: ...不然难免会有适得其反的情况出现。

bearing.sentence: It has some bearing on this problem.
bearing.translation: 它和这个问题有点关系。

correlation.translation: 相关关系不导致因果关系。

stove.sentence: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
stove.translation: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

upset.sentence: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
upset.translation: 自从公司合并了以后，一切都变得十分混乱。

upset.sentence: Sometimes being overcautious in planning could upset the apple cart.
upset.translation: 计划时如果过于谨慎的话，可能会反把计划搞乱。

cigar.sentence: I watched a ring of smoke that floated from his cigar into the air.
cigar.translation: 我看著一轮烟圈从他的雪茄里冒出来，飘到了空气中。

throw.sentence: Throw the ball back to me.
Throw a sprat to catch a whale.
They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
throw.translation: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。

involuntary.sentence: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
involuntary.translation: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

miss.sentence: We shall all miss you when you go away.
miss.translation: 你走了，我们都会想你的。

satisfaction.sentence: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
satisfaction.translation: 无论读书的目的是什么，书总会带给我们乐趣和满足。

insurance.sentence: Can I use my medical insurance?
insurance.translation: 我可以使用我的医疗保险吗？

insurance.sentence: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
insurance.translation: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

patriot.sentence: It is the duty of every patriot to protect his country from its government.
patriot.translation: 爱国者的责任就是保护国家不受政府侵犯。

eight.sentence: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
eight.translation: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。

eight.sentence: The boy has been absent from school for eight days.
eight.translation: 那个男孩已经有八天没上学了。

kindred.sentence: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.
kindred.translation: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。

repeatedly.sentence: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
repeatedly.translation: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。

perfection.sentence: His martial arts prowess has already reached a level of sublime perfection.
perfection.translation: 他的武功已经达到了出神入化的境界。

perfection.sentence: "I think perfection is ugly", he said. "Somewhere in the things that humans make, I want to see scars, failure, disorder, distortion."
perfection.translation: “我认为完美是丑陋的”，他说道。“人们做的事情，我希望看到的是创伤，失败，混乱，扭曲。”

harmonize.sentence: The third point to make is that Emmet attempted to harmonize his theory with the reality of designing.
harmonize.translation: 他的第三点说明的是，埃米特试图协调现实与他的理论设计。

nightmare.sentence: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
nightmare.translation: 我觉得我好像从恶梦中惊醒。

dull.sentence: The point of the pencil has become dull.
If not for music, the world would be a dull place.
dull.translation: 如果没有了音乐，这个世界一定会变得十分枯燥乏味。

dull.sentence: Were it not for music, the world would be a dull place.
dull.translation: 如果没有了音乐，这个世界就会变得十分沉闷。

impressive.translation: 我对她有很深刻的印象。

impressive.sentence: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
impressive.translation: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

wine.sentence: I'd like to have a glass of wine.
We'd like another bottle of wine.
wine.translation: 我们想再来一瓶葡萄酒。

uncover.sentence: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
uncover.translation: 我不敢探查得太深, 以免发现可怕的事实。

cheaper.sentence: Show me a cheaper one, please.
cheaper.translation: 请给我看看便宜一点的。

cheaper.sentence: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
cheaper.translation: 你们有没有比较便宜的房间？

cheaper.sentence: The things in this village are cheaper than those in ours.
cheaper.translation: 这条村的东西比我们村的便宜多了。

fresh.sentence: It is still fresh in my memory.
The event is still fresh in our memory.
fresh.translation: 那件事在我们的脑海中还记忆犹新。

fresh.sentence: Wouldn't you like to get some fresh air?
fresh.translation: 想出去呼吸一下新鲜空气吗？

household.sentence: She was busy with household work.
More and more married couples share household chores.
household.translation: 夫妻分担家务的情况愈来愈普遍。

household.sentence: Nowadays, equal pay is not enough. Household responsibilities must also be distributed evenly.
household.translation: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。

clerk.sentence: She is a clerk in the supermarket.
Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
clerk.translation: 每周六鲍勃在杂货店做店员。

lift.sentence: I can't lift my right arm.
lift.translation: 我无法举起我的右手臂。

lift.sentence: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.

captivate.sentence: He knows how to captivate his audience.
captivate.translation: 他知道如何去吸引他的听众。

develop.sentence: Our country must develop its natural resources.
develop.translation: 我们国家必须开发自然资源。

develop.sentence: Smokers are far more likely to develop lung cancer than non-smokers are.
develop.translation: 吸烟的人患上肺癌的风险比不吸烟的人高得多。

tripod.sentence: Your tripod is in my office.
tripod.translation: 你的三脚架在我的办公室里。

tripod.sentence: I've been looking for my tripod.
tripod.translation: 我一直在找我的三脚架。

burning.sentence: If you quit the job, you'll be burning your bridges.
burning.translation: 如果你辞掉这份工作，你将在自毁后路

burning.sentence: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
burning.translation: 诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。

gate.translation: 我把大门漆成了蓝色的。

gate.sentence: The car is waiting at the gate.

tag.sentence: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
tag.translation: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？

tag.sentence: I attached my name-tag to my baggage, but it soon came off.
tag.translation: 我在我的行李上附上了有我名字的标签, 但是它很快就剥落了。

tag.sentence: As he looked through the store window, Dima's eyes widened as they fell upon a gorgeous black suit, and then widened even more when he noticed the 3,000,000.99 BYR price tag.
tag.translation: 当狄马透过店外的窗子，看见里面一件华丽绝伦的黑色西装时，他不禁睁大了眼睛；接著，当他发现价钱牌上写著「3,000,000.99 BYR」的时候，他的眼睛就睁得更大了。

appear.sentence: My name doesn't appear on the list.
appear.translation: 我的名字没有出现在名单上。

appear.sentence: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.

pollute.sentence: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
pollute.translation: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。

bow.sentence: The girl made an awkward bow.
bow.translation: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

bow.sentence: The girl made an awkward bow.
